objective: Build KU2D Core Knowledge Backfill & Coverage Audit v1 without expanding acquisition scope
instructions: Work only on branch codex/ku2d-core-knowledge-backfill-v1 based on merge d594592f07594bba8d16ca0d42ec51b4861c6bf6.
Do not implement Survey, Google Forms, DoE, bias tooling, SEM, new source acquisition, new live requests, production scheduling, model training, embeddings, or inference.

Inspect repository-grounded historical KU2D acquisition evidence and prior reviewed artifacts for Lotus's, Big C, Makro, Tops, Gourmet Market, JIB, Shopee, Lazada, LINE SHOPPING, Q-Diving/YouTube, Coffee sources, TikTok access boundary, Agoda/Traveloka access boundary, NocNoc ceased-source evidence, and other high-confidence completed episodes actually present in the repository.

Create a generic KU2D Core Knowledge taxonomy that separates Source Characteristics, Acquisition Technique, Execution Environment, Evidence Type, Semantic Interpretation, Acquisition Outcome, Failure/Boundary Type, Transferability, Evidence Strength, Review/Authority, Change/Drift, Data Quality/Yield, Request Cost/Latency when evidenced, Privacy/Authorization class, and provenance.

Preserve explicit distinctions such as Technique != Execution Environment, Evidence != Interpretation, Observation != Ground Truth, Displayed Order != Demand, Product Identity != Variant Identity, and blocked access != extraction failure when supported by reviewed evidence.

Backfill only high-confidence sanitized historical learning episodes from repository evidence. Do not fabricate human review, exact observations, timestamps, request counts, costs, or source outcomes that are not supported.
Represent both positive and negative learning episodes, including blocked/challenge/application-shell/ceased-source cases where repository evidence exists.
Introduce a Reviewed Learning Corpus concept separate from raw Learning Memory and from future ML Training Datasets. Define eligibility/provenance rules but do not export or train any ML dataset.

Create an ML Knowledge Map identifying future supervised-learning tasks that existing reviewed evidence could eventually support, such as price semantics, counter semantics, source classification, technique selection, access outcome prediction, field semantic mapping, evidence-strength classification, and review prioritization. For each task, identify candidate inputs/features, target label, current evidence source, label authority, leakage risks, and current readiness. Do not claim readiness where evidence is insufficient.

Build a Core Coverage Matrix across acquisition capabilities/patterns rather than counting websites. At minimum assess official API, sitemap/static discovery, canonical detail extraction, rendered DOM, browser acquisition, app-bundle discovery, structured response use, pagination, execution-environment dependence, authentication boundary handling, change monitoring, incremental refresh, entity resolution, cross-source matching, temporal observation, semantic normalization, quality/yield, and provenance/review maturity. Use qualitative states with evidence references and explicit gaps.

Produce a ranked Knowledge Gap Register. Recommend future exploration targets by the acquisition pattern/gap they would test, not merely by brand/domain popularity. Do not start those explorations in this prompt.
Keep the core taxonomy and corpus storage-neutral, versioned, deterministic, JSON/JSONL compatible, safe, and logically separate from production authorization and coordination records.

Add deterministic tests for schema validation, provenance, authority, contradiction handling, negative episodes, taxonomy IDs, coverage states, corpus eligibility, sensitive-material rejection, and no automatic runtime writes.
Add documentation explaining Learning Memory -> Reviewed Learning Corpus -> future task-specific ML Training Dataset, and why the latter does not yet exist.

Run git diff --check, JSON/YAML parsing, Python compilation, all Learning Memory and Agent Handoff tests, complete deterministic Data Acquisition corpus, and relevant domain regressions. Live request count must remain 0.
Open a new Draft PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform titled 'KU2D: Add Core Knowledge Backfill v1'. Do not merge.

When complete, write KU2D-R-000004 with exact branch, PR number, commit SHAs, files changed, taxonomy/schema additions, historical episodes included/excluded and why, coverage matrix summary, Knowledge Gap Register, ML Knowledge Map, tests/CI/security, live request count, production boundary, uncertainties, and blockers. Update queue so next_action.actor=assistant and stop.

provenance.design_intent: strengthen KU2D core and preserve ML-ready reviewed knowledge before expanding acquisition scope
